name: Claude Austin
original_name: クロード・オースティン
source:
Favorite tea: Sikkim

A troublesome adult who flirts with women as a form of greeting. He treats Donna the same, but it's unclear how serious he is. It sometimes seems like he's just teasing her. He also has an intelligent aura and sometimes gives advice based on experience. He seems to come from an intellectual background, but you don't hear him say that much himself. He values ​​not only the taste but also the aroma of tea.

[Translated from the [url=https://dotaihen.xxxxxxxx.jp/tea/teaparty.htm]official website[/url]]
